meta.title: A request without the weightages object is refused
gaps: The case's one valid weight value is unspecified, so the request uses an empty values object.
The available read-back fields cannot verify that no weight was saved or that the round remains unweighted.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the trade edit weight parameters request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Insufficient parameters”, and never with a server error.
